tasks.title: Baseline de producto y entorno
tasks.acceptance: PRD y versiones fijadas; revisar alcance y preparar daemon/fixtures aislados; ningún proyecto real alterado

evidence.notes: Versions pinned; isolated daemon (own home/port) started and checked; fixtures created; no real project touched.
evidence.limitations: No provider inference; credential sharing with regular home not verified.

tasks.title: Contrato del compositor y routing inicial
tasks.acceptance: POC-01/02: control nativo, opt-in, metadata, proveedor correcto antes de inferencia y sesión normal intacta

evidence.notes: POC-01/02 on Paseo 0.17.4 (isolated daemon, web build in headless Chrome, OpenCode free inference only): addComposerItem/addNewWorkspaceItem host the opt-in control; host settings persist it; agent.create.before applies provider/model/mode before any session/inference, fails closed on throw or invalid provider, respects manual override, leaves non-opted-in sessions untouched. FAIL rows: 1.8 (workspace metadata does not reach initial agent), 1.10 (setProvider at cold mount rejected) - design implications recorded.
evidence.limitations: Electron window, compact/mobile/theme, plugin-down and hook-timeout (fail-open expected), multi-plugin ordering, restart persistence and type-checking NOT RUN; surfaces missing from plugin reference docs were found in the runtime.

tasks.title: Catálogo y cuotas
tasks.acceptance: POC-03: captura saneada de API pública real, freshness, reset, unknown y compatibilidad 0.17.4

evidence.notes: POC-03: providers.snapshot()/listUsage() and CLI usage ls verified on Paseo 0.17.4 in an isolated daemon with an empty profile and a synthetic usage source (0, 100, null, absent, resetsAt, no_quota preserved). Empty profile => unknown for every provider.
evidence.limitations: Real authenticated account quotas NOT RUN (credentials deliberately excluded; needs owner approval of scope); usage inspect of an existing report BLOCKED by a port collision with another POC; other Paseo versions NOT RUN.

tasks.title: Roles, herramientas y permisos
tasks.acceptance: POC-04/05/06: agente directo, caller identity, MCP on/off y matriz de restricciones reales

evidence.notes: POC-04 PASS (direct agent creation, no Agent Profiles, caller-chosen agentId). POC-05 PASS WITH CONDITIONS: per-session tool injection before first turn works, but caller identity on the Paseo-MCP route (callerAgentId URL param) is spoofable (05.3 FAIL); identity-safe route is a plugin-hosted MCP server with per-session bearer secret (verified on OpenCode/Codex, authenticated connect on Claude). POC-06 restriction matrix produced: Paseo tool policy is per provider only; per-session deny works for Claude (Bash/Task/Agent) and OpenCode (bash); agent.open.before parent-label veto blocks child creation; Codex shell not removable (behavioral anti-recursion).
evidence.limitations: Several matrix cells NOT RUN (Codex subagent switch, Claude mcp__paseo deny, OpenCode permission.task, non-default thinking, own-MCP secret exposure to same-user processes, daemon password mode). Claude/Codex per-session restriction claims are model-reported. Inference used: Claude 2, Codex 2, OpenCode free 8 trivial prompts.

tasks.title: Subagentes y worktrees
tasks.acceptance: POC-07/08: relación padre-hijo visible, checkout separado y base exacta

evidence.notes: POC-07: visible native parent-child relationship across workspaces; result, cancellation and manual denial verified. POC-08: exact base SHA, independent checkouts and common Git dir verified.
evidence.limitations: OpenCode Free on Windows/Paseo 0.17.4; positive permission approval and other providers NOT RUN.

evidence.notes: POC-08 teardown: native archive removed tracked edits and an untracked file from a disposable dirty worktree.
evidence.limitations: Release use of parallel writable worktrees requires a safe lifecycle decision at G0. Local Git and lifecycle POCs can proceed in fixtures.

evidence.command: Paseo agent status for parent and two project children
evidence.notes: Existing child sessions retained task labels and lost native parent labels after outside archival of the previous coordinator.
evidence.limitations: Technical fencing, durability and coordinator succession still require S05-T04.

evidence.notes: Paseo archived external workspace records and retained both checkouts. Plain Git rejected dirty removal and removed only the clean disposable checkout.
evidence.limitations: Externally owned fixtures only. Managed teardown still uses force; integrated history and ignored files still need explicit validation.

evidence.check: POC-07 logical lineage after coordinator archive
evidence.notes: New coordinator metadata and local history retained task lineage across archive and ordered restart. Same-workspace child archived; cross-workspace child detached.
evidence.limitations: Mock sessions without prompts. Native reparenting and active jobs not verified.

tasks.title: Git y publicación de prueba
tasks.acceptance: POC-09/10/15: integración, recuperación de conflictos, PR privado, checks por SHA, rechazos y capacidad efectiva de protecciones/auto-merge

evidence.notes: Integrated two exact-base branches and verified both outputs on the consolidated fixture.
evidence.limitations: Local Git worktrees on Windows.

evidence.notes: A new Git process recovered merge state; abort and resolution preserved the branches; reattempt did not move HEAD.
evidence.limitations: Git process recovery only. No Paseo active turn or product journal exercised.

evidence.command: gh pr view; gh run list
evidence.notes: Private sandbox: branch push and PR #1. Fixture check failed on initial head and succeeded on corrected exact SHA; local, remote, PR and run matched.
evidence.limitations: Synthetic fixtures only.

evidence.command: GitHub API: merge with stale sha, anonymous POST /issues, self approval
evidence.notes: HTTP 409 for stale SHA, HTTP 401 for anonymous write and HTTP 422 for author self-approval. The base was unchanged.
evidence.limitations: Required branch rules and positive independent approval were not exercised.

evidence.command: GitHub API: branch protection, effective rules and allow_auto_merge
evidence.notes: Private plan rejected protections and effective rules with HTTP 403. Auto-merge setting stayed false. Kept PR open.
evidence.limitations: No live branch-rule rejection, auto-merge, or queue. No visibility change.

blockers: The authorized private sandbox cannot enable branch protection or auto-merge under its current plan. Required-rule rejection and protected automatic merge remain unverified.

tasks.title: Servicios y aprobación
tasks.acceptance: POC-11/17: servicio ligado a versión y aprobación de tarea/SHA por actor autenticado; operación manual si la UI carece de procedencia verificable

evidence.command: rpc.mjs scripts/start/stop; /health direct and via proxy; TCP forward
evidence.notes: Isolated Paseo 0.17.4 service reached healthy, returned exact fixture SHA over both URLs and stopped. The same server through a different loopback port returned the original proxy URL.
evidence.limitations: Bundled daemon client and simulated tunnel only. Plugin SDK launch and real remote host NOT RUN.

evidence.command: Recovered T07 daemon log and isolated runtime traces
evidence.notes: Panel bound action to exact SHA and rejected stale requests. UI and generic client shared the same handler context, which exposed no authentic human actor.
evidence.limitations: No trusted chat approval path or external review mechanism verified.

evidence.notes: All nine original files were preserved byte-for-byte in a local commit on the original task branch.
Pinned runtime analysis corroborated the T07 panel run: plugin RPC receives no authenticated human actor. A caller-supplied client type has no authority.
evidence.limitations: Separated external authentication is a design alternative. The sandbox rejected self-review; a positive independently authenticated flow remains unverified.

blockers: Paseo 0.17.4 plugin RPC does not expose independently verifiable human provenance. Use manual-only handling pending a verified authority and owner approval of scope.

tasks.title: Persistencia, aislamiento y privacidad
tasks.acceptance: POC-12/13/14/16: recuperar pendientes al reiniciar sin otorgar permisos, preservar el entorno al retirar y atribuir tráfico y estado exportado

evidence.notes: Stop/start gave a new daemon PID. The workspace service stopped and the in-memory pending approval was lost.
evidence.limitations: Agent turns and native pending permissions were not exercised.

evidence.notes: Independent plugin and native workspace service remained available across removal of the test plugin.
evidence.limitations: No new provider turn. OpenCode was unavailable for a new control agent; reused the unmanaged session evidence from S00-T02.

evidence.notes: Disable/remove made plugin RPCs unavailable while preserving the control plugin, service, branch, and untracked file.
evidence.limitations: Fixture scope only. Native profiles and memory stores were not exercised.

evidence.notes: Listener PID differed from the recorded PID. One established non-loopback TCP connection was observed on the listener process and left unattributed. The isolated daemon log recorded background speech model downloads during startup.
evidence.limitations: The connection was not correlated with a particular operation. A sanitized export passed only on synthetic data.

evidence.notes: Allowlisted fixture export dropped synthetic paths, notes, messages and credential. Malformed allowed fields were rejected.
evidence.limitations: Synthetic input only. A real daemon state export was not tested.

evidence.notes: 31 checks passed in real Windows Paseo stop/start across two workspaces. Preserved pending requests and invalidated stale SHA or policy. Consume mock had no effect.
evidence.limitations: Authentication, process death during write, concurrent writers and native active turns were not exercised.

evidence.notes: Four controls with dictation and plugin toggles. Correlated both connections per enabled control to Paseo speech-model downloads, none in disabled controls.
evidence.limitations: Original T08 socket unidentifiable, no historical endpoint. Child processes, IPv6, transient sockets and real-state export remain unverified.

blockers: Ordered restart of synthetic approvals passed. Active runs, crash/concurrency and effects reconciliation remain unverified.
Reproduced traffic was attributed to Paseo speech downloads. Historical endpoint, wider traffic scope and real-state export remain unverified.

tasks.title: ADR y gate G0
tasks.acceptance: Revisión independiente y aprobación condicionada de Foundation; validaciones del MVP completo siguen como prerequisitos de G9.

evidence.command: Review S00 runtime, GitHub and local evidence
evidence.notes: The full MVP has unresolved G0 blockers. A separate local-only supervised scope is proposed and unapproved.
evidence.limitations: G0 remains unapproved. S01 is outside scope.

evidence.command: node tools/check-planning.mjs; git diff --check; local synthetic tests and Node syntax
evidence.notes: Review completed. No-go for full G0; conditional viability for explicitly owner-approved local-only development with one supervised writer, manual reconciliation and manual sensitive actions.
evidence.limitations: Review completion is not gate approval. Remaining capabilities require validation.

evidence.notes: Local evidence and manual handoff. No product GitHub operations, automatic succession, live archival or automatic cleanup in the proposed scope.
evidence.limitations: Requires explicit owner approval and updated scoped acceptance before S01.

evidence.notes: Scope corrections verified. Full G0 blocked; supervised local-only scope conditionally viable for development after explicit owner approval and scoped plan update.
evidence.limitations: Release privacy and retirement tests remain pending. Review is not gate approval.

evidence.notes: The owner explicitly authorized S01 under the Foundation scope. The original MVP, its pending validations and the later gates are retained.
evidence.limitations: Approval covers local supervised implementation on Windows with Paseo 0.17.4. Distribution and higher maturity require separate validation and approval.

tasks.title: Scaffold y manifest
tasks.acceptance: Plugin mínimo instala y carga cliente/servidor en versión validada; sin hooks invasivos

evidence.notes: Plugin sources (index.client.tsx, index.server.ts, client/, server/, shared/) typecheck against @getpaseo/plugin 0.17.4 with exact SDK pin and committed lockfile.
evidence.limitations: CI matrix is S01-T02; no unit tests yet.

evidence.command: isolated daemon (own home, loopback port, relay off): paseo plugin install <repo>; plugin ls; headless Chrome on the app web build
evidence.notes: Server: plugin status running, method zelqio.status registered, no lifecycle hooks. Client: sidebar item and screen rendered; the screen displayed the RPC response (v0.0.0, foundation, effects off). Regular daemon untouched and still listening; temporary home, browser profile and processes removed.
evidence.limitations: Client verified in the web build of the installed app, not the desktop shell. Only Windows with Paseo 0.17.4. Plugin trust prompt accepted by the CLI for a local path.

tasks.title: CI y harness
tasks.acceptance: Typecheck lint unit tests en matriz Windows/macOS/Linux; sin secretos o inferencia en CI

evidence.notes: tsc clean; eslint (typescript-eslint recommended) clean; 2 unit tests passed.
evidence.limitations: Only the status contract is covered so far.

evidence.command: GitHub Actions workflow ci: npm ci --ignore-scripts, typecheck, lint, tests on ubuntu, windows and macos (Node 24)
evidence.notes: All three matrix jobs and planning-integrity passed on the PR. Actions pinned by SHA, read-only token, no secrets, no inference.
evidence.limitations: The ci jobs are not yet required status checks on main; changing branch protection needs owner authorization. Plugin install/load on macOS and Linux is not covered.

tasks.title: Persistencia y migraciones
tasks.acceptance: Settings versionados, almacenamiento atómico, backup y recuperación ante corrupción probados

evidence.notes: 27 tests, 15 for the store: versioned round trip, backup, migration, recovery from backup, reset with corrupt copy preserved, newer-version write refusal, schema rejection, failed migration, bounded corrupt copies, serialized concurrent saves, failure injected at four save steps (found and fixed a leaked backup temp file).
evidence.limitations: Single process only: cross-process locking, power loss during flush and the plugin storage location are not covered; no settings are defined yet, so the store is not wired to the plugin. Tracked in the validation matrix (persistence rows).

evidence.command: GitHub Actions workflow ci on ubuntu, windows and macos
evidence.notes: typecheck, lint and tests passed on the three platforms, including filesystem behavior of atomic rename.
evidence.limitations: Independent review of this high-risk task is deferred to the G1 review.

tasks.title: RPC y contratos core
tasks.acceptance: Tipos/validación runtime, errores normalizados, mocks SDK; contratos aprobados

evidence.notes: 9 tests: envelope success, ZelqioError normalization with retry hint, internal errors hide paths and messages, input contract rejection before the handler, duplicate registration rejected, unwrapResult, ZodError to invalid_input.
evidence.limitations: The test double validates with the contract Zod schemas; the SDK callPluginRpc is not public API, so wire behaviour is covered by the daemon check.

evidence.command: isolated daemon (own home, loopback port, relay off): plugin install from the working tree; headless Chrome on the web app
evidence.notes: The status screen rendered the unwrapped envelope (v0.0.0, foundation, effects off) through the real daemon and client.
evidence.limitations: Web build of the app on Windows with Paseo 0.17.4 only. Error envelopes on the wire are covered by unit tests, not by the daemon check.

tasks.title: UI base e internacionalización
tasks.acceptance: Componentes nativos, EN/ES y temas; no traducciones faltantes

evidence.notes: 12 tests including EN/ES key parity, placeholder parity and no empty strings.
evidence.limitations: Parity is checked on the resource files; there is no locale beyond EN and ES.

evidence.command: isolated daemon + headless Chrome on the app web build; app language system then es
evidence.notes: Status screen rendered with native components and SDK translations: English (Version 0.0.0 / Foundation / Effects disabled) and Spanish (Versión 0.0.0 / Foundation / Efectos desactivados); no raw keys shown. Sidebar title uses an SDK message.
evidence.limitations: Theme variants (light/dark) were not captured; colors come from the host theme tokens. Web build only, Windows, Paseo 0.17.4.
